what: A vertical color band twice the screen height (transparent at the bottom → three colors → transparent) waits below the screen. When a same-site link is clicked it rises in .5s power2.out to 25% of the band height above the screen, covering it like a rainbow, and the page changes. On the new page, after .1s the band leaves upward (−150%) in .5s power2.in and clears. Because the top and bottom ends are transparent, the color slides up and out with no visible edge

options.links: When off, links are not intercepted — when Barba · swup transitions, they call the element’s fxRainbowRisePage.cover() · reveal() (Promise)
options.--fx-c1: Color at the bottom of the band, default var(--kf-accent-soft)
options.--fx-c3: Band top color (the color that enters first), default var(--kf-accent)

note: In the original, at the Barba transition step the band is raised (leave), the scroll jumps to the top in .1s, the new page is inserted, then the band withdraws (enter). When returning with the back button, it jumps straight to the saved scroll position and then withdraws

from.where: shared.js barba default-transition (.bg-rainbow — yellow·pink·sky bands, z 101 · 49 above 768px)
